title: The brief, the options and the review come back from the tool as text the human can read in the chat
description: Today write_brief returns only '<node> has a brief. Show it to the human…' (packages/mcp/src/tools/plan.ts ~466), so the agent has to rebuild the brief itself and often just points at the board. Add a renderBrief(node, brief) to packages/mcp/src/render.ts: title, approach, and every acceptance criterion (command + what passing proves). Return it from write_brief and from the brief tool. Check renderDecisions gives every option with label, reason and costLater, and renderReview the findings and criteria — fill whatever is missing. End each block with one line: 'Paste this above the question before you ask.' Test: snapshot/unit tests next to render.ts covering a brief with two criteria and a decision with three options. Scope follows the relay decision: under prose-only this node shrinks to only checking what renderDecisions/renderReview already carry.
